title: On $α$-entropy solutions of a nonlocal thin film equation: existence and finite speed of propagation
summary: We consider an initial-boundary value problem for a class of nonlocal thin film equations governed by the spectral fractional Laplacian with homogeneous Neumann boundary conditions. We were the first to establish an $α$-entropy estimate for nonlocal thin film equations, which yields essential a priori bounds for the regularity and long-time behavior of weak solutions. By developing a localized version of this estimate, we prove finite speed of propagation, showing that the support of nonnegative solutions remains compact for positive times.
